description: Легковесный SDK для лицензирования AutoCAD-плагинов через платформу GrossGeo. Тонкий клиент с IPC-коммуникацией к User Panel.
releaseNotes:
v2.4.0 (ships together with the 2.4.0 panels; three new local APIs, all of them never throw and never touch the network or the licence pipe, no Initialize needed, one build for .NET Framework 4.8 and .NET 8: 1) cloud settings - GrossGeo.SDK.Settings, GrossGeoCloudSettings.For(productKey) (Get/Put/Delete/Changes/AskConflict, a Changed event on a pool thread; writes are queued while the panel is closed, Unavailable if the participant never signed in on this machine; documents up to 5 MB, keys up to 256 chars); 2) anonymous command usage counters - GrossGeo.SDK.Telemetry, GrossGeoUsage.For(productKey) (SubmitTotals/AddCounts write a local per-day file, the panel sends completed days; nothing is written without consent - NotConsented); 3) agreements and consent - GrossGeo.SDK.Legal, GrossGeoAgreements.For(productKey) (GetState/Accept/SetTelemetryConsent/Changed; decisions are queued for the panel, a revocation takes effect at once and offline); guide: https://github.com/2805028/Grossgeo-Platform-SDK/blob/HEAD/docs/grossgeo-sdk-2.4-guide.md): see CHANGELOG.md in the package.
v2.3.0 (REQUIRED for the platform release that ships it: releases submitted to the platform must be built against SDK 2.3.0 or newer - the server refuses a submission whose SDK is older (SDK_STUB_VERSION_TOO_OLD), products are rebuilt and re-uploaded (note: the gate only checks .NET 8+ assemblies - net48 builds and MSI installers are not checked); the SDK now carries the PUBLIC PEMs of the central signing keys itself, so switching to the backup key needs no product reinstall and no server change; the SDK now verifies the process on the other end of the license pipe, so a response from a foreign process is never accepted; and the feature key material is now kept in the signed offline cache, bound to the machine and covered by the signature, served only to a paid verdict with a signed machine): see CHANGELOG.md in the package.
v2.2.6 (recommended: SDK messages follow the AutoCAD interface language - English for any language but Russian, so do not compare Message, branch on Status and ErrorCode, and call Initialize from the AutoCAD main thread; PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND is now a final refusal - no endless background re-checks and no offline cache, a product deleted without being blocked loses its cache at once, a developer checking a product before publication gets the refusal at once; a machine-fingerprint failure now leaves its reason in the SDK journal): see CHANGELOG.md in the package.
Earlier versions: v2.2.5 (REQUIRED - fixes the verification-key cache that the SDK wrote on AutoCAD 2019-2024 and then could not use, closes a licence served from the offline cache with the machine clock more than 2 hours behind the latest time the SDK had seen for that product, removes the 15-second first-check delay that SDK 2.2.4 introduced on AutoCAD 2025 and later, and keeps the offline licence cache in the folder of the product that owns it), v2.2.4 (recommended if your product uses Concurrent seats or targets a machine whose WMI can be slow to start - a background seat retry with SessionResult.IsRetrying and the SessionAcquired event, a 15-second WMI window with the transient MACHINE_NOT_IDENTIFIED, the offline cache kept per runtime, per-product cache folders, and a mechanism that reads what a product was built against from its own assembly reference), v2.2.3 (REQUIRED - closes an AutoCAD crash and an AutoCAD 2019-2024 hang caused by the SDK, and a Concurrent seat being lost without any event) and older - see CHANGELOG.md in the public repository, https://github.com/2805028/Grossgeo-Platform-SDK/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
